sol.label: Preview app
sol.detail: The switcher puts a check beside Default and lists Preview app directly below it.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: The MX Master 4 adds Haptic Sense Panel at marker 6. After Save name, Spare button appears below the numbered rows.

sol.label: Gesture button tap
sol.detail: In the compact list the Win and Tab keycaps sit next to Task View. The no-device list keeps that action and shows the offline editing notice.

sol.label: System
sol.detail: Selecting System swaps the action list to Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right, and Show desktop. In the wide layout the thumb button image stays in place.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: The Copy query returns one result under Edit with Ctrl and C keycaps. The empty state keeps the clear field control and offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

sol.label: Save pointer speed action
sol.detail: Set up opens two DPI inputs and sliders at 800 and 1600. The number 5 and its close-up stay in view as the editor changes.

sol.label: Save shortcut
sol.detail: M survives resizing into the compact dialog. Cancel restores Native action, then saving K updates the Back button row and the reopened editor still shows K. The compact chord fits all four modifiers plus Space.

sol.label: Ignore accidental nudges
sol.detail: The SmartShift view shows a threshold of 4 with an off-to-8 slider. The limited view shows Always ratchet selected and omits both sliders.

sol.label: Saved gesture actions
sol.detail: Turning gestures off removes the threshold and leaves Tap and the four swipe mappings visible. The directional arrows lose their accent.

sol.label: Picking in 4s
sol.detail: The countdown appears beside Cancel in the Preview app card. After the pick, python.exe appears beside preview.exe with its own remove control.

sol.label: Disconnected
sol.detail: The disconnected card says saved mappings are still editable. No device instead asks for a mouse connection, and the standard USB view shows only Connection.

sol.label: HID++ features
sol.detail: The page pairs amber fixed-width hex codes with feature names and puts unnamed IDs in separate chips beside Copy IDs.

sol.label: Couldn't save assignment
sol.detail: The Back button panel identifies Copy as unsaved, says the previous assignment is still active, and offers Try again and Back to editing.

sol.label: Resume remapping
sol.detail: Pause remapping changes to Resume remapping, while Start with Windows remains checked. Dividers set off Open mouse settings and Quit Mushak.

terra.label: Buttons
terra.detail: Profile menu shows Default checked above Preview app.

terra.label: Additional button 1
terra.detail: Naming dialog contains Spare button, which appears under Outside the diagram after saving.

terra.label: Gesture button tap
terra.detail: Compact list pairs Win and Tab keycaps with Task View.

terra.label: Back button
terra.detail: System category lists Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right and Show desktop.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: A search for zzzz offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

terra.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
terra.detail: The editor shows 800 and 1600 DPI fields beside sliders and a save button.

terra.label: Keyboard shortcut
terra.detail: Recording changes to a draft, survives resizing, and saving K produces a confirmation and a saved state on reopen.

terra.label: Scroll
terra.detail: SmartShift is selected and Flick sensitivity is 10, with high-resolution scrolling enabled.

terra.label: Gestures
terra.detail: Swipe left maps to Desktop left and the off state explains saved actions take effect when enabled.

terra.label: Profiles
terra.detail: Picking a window shows a countdown, and the resulting Preview app profile includes python.exe.

terra.label: Device
terra.detail: Connected view shows Bluetooth, firmware, 50% battery and 1000 DPI; disconnected view gives reconnection guidance.

terra.label: HID++ features
terra.detail: The diagnostics list names 0x2201 Adjustable DPI and provides Copy IDs for unnamed features.

terra.label: Couldn't save assignment
terra.detail: The error says Copy is unsaved and the previous assignment remains active, with Try again and Back to editing.

terra.label: Pause remapping
terra.detail: The tray menu changes Pause remapping to Resume remapping and keeps Start with Windows checked.

astra.label: Profile Default
astra.detail: The profile menu marks Default with an amber check and places Preview app below it in both themes. The persistent MX Master 2S card shows Connected and 50%.

astra.label: Spare button
astra.detail: The MX Master 4 diagram has six numbered markers. An unplaced control sits below Outside the diagram, and saving Spare button replaces Additional button 1 in that row.

astra.label: Gesture button tap
astra.detail: The compact mapping list pairs Back button with Ctrl and W keycaps and Close tab. Gesture button tap includes the second line Set swipes in Gestures.

astra.label: Assign an action
astra.detail: Selecting System shows Task View, Desktop left, Desktop right and Show desktop. The side illustration retains marker 2 above the thumb buttons while the editor remains aligned beside it.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: Searching Copy replaces the category column with an Edit heading and one result with Ctrl and C keycaps. The empty result state offers Record a keyboard shortcut.

astra.label: Save pointer speed action
astra.detail: The wheel editor offers Switch wheel mode with Assign and Switch pointer speed with Set up. The latter opens Speed 1 at 800 and Speed 2 at 1600, each with a DPI field and slider.

astra.label: Save shortcut
astra.detail: The ordered frames move from Record key to Press a key, an M draft, cancellation, a K draft, a saved K toast and a reopened editor showing Saved. The original chord image fits Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space beside Change key.

astra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: SmartShift has an amber selected border and radio mark. Flick sensitivity is 10 and Ignore accidental nudges is 4. The limited state removes both sliders and selects Always ratchet.

astra.label: Gestures are off. The assignments below take effect when you turn gestures on.
astra.detail: The enabled view has a 60 counts threshold and amber directional arrows. Turning gestures off removes the threshold, changes the arrows to muted gray and retains the saved action rows.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: The capture state shows Picking in 4s beside Cancel. The original captured result adds python.exe to Preview app, with priority badges 1 and 2 and Move down or Move up controls.

astra.label: Reapply settings
astra.detail: The connected device view shows Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, battery 50% and Current DPI 1000. Disconnected and No device use separate plain-language messages, and USB mouse shows only its reported connection.

astra.label: HID++ features
astra.detail: Named feature IDs appear in amber monospace beside names such as Adjustable DPI. Unnamed features occupy compact ID chips with a Copy IDs button and a compatibility-report explanation.

astra.label: Couldn't save assignment
astra.detail: The save-error panel says Copy is still unsaved and the previous assignment is still active, with Try again and Back to editing. The conflict banner changes from Logi Options+ is running to an access-denied error with Retry quit.

astra.label: Resume remapping
astra.detail: The tray menu changes Pause remapping to Resume remapping while retaining the check next to Start with Windows. Separators isolate Open mouse settings and Quit Mushak.
